description: Review-only external dependency updates for CEE and its test workspaces. The train remains the only authority for the TypeScript model input and frontend output versions.

packageRules.description: The model-library alias is wired by the immutable build train after that exact model package is published and verified.
Major upgrades require explicit approval in the Dependency Dashboard.
Angular framework, build, lint, Material, and runtime packages must move as one tested platform.
Keep ESLint and TypeScript-ESLint packages compatible in one pull request.
CEE, its domain harness, and coverage tooling use one Vitest line.
Review TypeScript updates across the root and harness workspaces together.
Keep lodash-es and its type definitions aligned across CEE workspaces.
Keep package engines, .nvmrc, and the GitHub Actions runtime on one Node.js version decision.
